scope: SDevice-only n23 drain-first-layer QF and self-consistent feedback audit

perturbation.target_selection: all noncontact QF columns incident to the drain-first-layer continuity rows

claim_policy: Finite-difference perturbations are read-only frozen-state diagnostics and do not alter a converged branch.
Direct terminal sensitivity and adjoint relaxation sensitivity must be reported separately.
First-order adjoint predictions may diagnose a pathway but do not replace the finite self-consistent HFS-on/off difference.
Node IDs are derived from the current n23 drain-cut topology rather than inherited from an earlier mesh.
The response rows are the five drain-first-layer nodes; the perturbation columns include their complete noncontact one-ring so internal-edge cancellation is not truncated.
No contact, HFS, SG, mobility, or solver default may be changed from this diagnostic alone.
